Price: Cash, bank transfer 12,000 won / card 13,000 won

Basic 2 hours on both weekdays and weekends, piece cake (1 cake for 2 people), unlimited self-bar use.

Hideout 2 Room Cafe is on the 3rd floor and there is no elevator. It was difficult because I went on a day when I had a suitcase.

There is a counter to the left of the entrance, and a self-serve bar and shoe cabinet to the right. Even though it's just a small self-portrait, it looks good for snacking. 3 types of cookies, ice cream, Americano, 2 types of slushies, popcorn, and many beverages available. There were more rooms on the 4th floor than on the 3rd floor, so I was guided to the 4th floor, and there were some board games on the stairs. It's also great to go and have fun with a group.

At this time, I thought it would be a good idea to go as a group and have fun, but paying 13,000 won per person and only staying for about 2 hours is not cost-effective. The group may be able to stay a little longer.

I tried different types of cookies, and all three types of cookies were tasteless, but the popcorn was delicious. The ice cream and cake were decent enough to eat. I just brought popcorn and coffee once more.

I thought the room would be small, but it was bigger than I thought. You look perfect while watching Netflix. I think it will be enough for 4-5 people.

Since I couldn't eat lunch, I ordered ramen (3,500 won) and it was cooked in the style of Han River ramen. If I knew I had to go out in 2 hours, I would have gone out and eaten. Anyway, the ramen was delicious.

It was written in large letters that it was unlimited use unless it was fully booked, but it seemed like they were kicked out after 2 hours and 15 to 20 minutes. There was no waiting line and the room was empty, but I got a call informing me to check out.

I guess it was a promise that couldn't be kept unless it was full or unlimited.

reviews.author: Gh Go
reviews.text: These days, I go to this place whenever I can't concentrate while working from home. The space between the seats is wide, so it's perfect for working with my laptop open. The Americano has a slightly sour taste, but it suits me just fine. Croffles are crispy on the outside and chewy on the inside, so ordering one as a snack will fill you up for the afternoon. I keep coming back because I enjoy drinking coffee while looking out from the window seat. It feels like the staff quietly cares about you, so it's an atmosphere where you can stay comfortably for a long time.

reviews.author: Sohee Choi
reviews.text:
I was worried because I was a non-major and an idiot, but the teacher with 20 years of experience kindly guided me from start to finish, so I had a lot of fun completing the drawing!
The quality of the work improved significantly as they carefully checked it all the way through and even gave it a final touch at the end.
Although it was my first time learning oil painting, I felt no pressure at all, and as I immersed myself in it, I was completely healed for the first time in a long time.
I highly recommend this to anyone who finds art difficult! The atmosphere is great too :)

reviews.author: Flower Hyewon
reviews.text:
It was located in a quiet place, so I was able to draw to my heart's content in a quiet atmosphere. More than anything, I was able to draw the picture I wanted to my heart's content, so it was a very enjoyable and happy time ^^

I had been giving up on painting, but I think this was a small opportunity for me to muster up the courage to look at it again. I plan to continue drawing from now on..!!
